_comment: Sensitivity metadata read by the framework's PII firewall (tools/_lib.sh). The raw_github_* entries make the firewall fire on the bundled worked example; the example_* tables are placeholders for adopters to replace with their real schema.

_sensitivity_values.pii: Directly identifies a person (names, emails, IDs, phone, address, DOB).
_sensitivity_values.restricted: Sensitive non-identifying (account numbers, medical, behavioural, financial).
_sensitivity_values.json_sensitive: JSON/STRUCT-bearing column whose contents may contain PII. Requires safe-key discovery before bulk extraction.

_adapt_for_your_source: Replace the example_* tables with your real ones. The raw_github_* entries are bundled with the worked example; keep them if you use the GitHub source, remove if you're targeting a different API.
